final_message:
Completed the standard-depth PubMed strategy. The final query is saved as one line in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/CD011926/pubmed-search-builder-next-codex-noseed-20260927T002229Z/final_strategy.txt). The full line-by-line strategy and audit are in [work/audit.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/CD011926/pubmed-search-builder-next-codex-noseed-20260927T002229Z/work/audit.md).

The search uses three required blocks: newborns, sepsis or bloodstream infection, and molecular assays. It applies the 2014-08-09 publication cutoff and the matching PubMed entry-date bound. The final count was **1,479** records.

All **12 of 12** screened development records were retrieved. This is relative recall against records used during development, not independent validation or sensitivity. The two-round PRESS-structured internal critique has no open must-fix findings; information-specialist PRESS peer review is still needed before use.
